item.title: Half-Kelly Position Sizing with Fractional Take-Profit
item.description:
Another piece of our v2.0 architecture: **how much to bet** and **when to exit**.
## Half Kelly
Full Kelly: f* = (p*b - q) / b
We use **half Kelly** because: 1. Full Kelly = huge drawdowns 2. Half captures ~75% growth with lower variance 3. Our estimates (p, b) are noisy
## Current Setup (~100 USDT) - Max margin: 10 USDT per trade (10%) - Min margin: 2 USDT (below = fees eat edge) - Daily loss limit: 5 USDT (stop trading) - Leverage: 20x crossed margin
